column4: cleat#2298's M4: forEachDialect loops this test over postgres/mysql/mssql via t.Run(string(dialect), ...) in engine/a_secret_rotation_test.go. multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so the postgres arm skips -- its own line, not the broad /postgres$ suffix line, per cleat#2729 (a specific line's matches are removed from the pool before any broad line is checked, so this does not require bumping that line's count).
same test, same reason, the mssql arm.

cleat#2298's M4 for DeploymentSecretStore, in engine/a_deployment_secret_store_db_test.go. This one calls testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) directly with no t.Run wrapper -- unlike the rotation test above, it only ever exercises Postgres (DeploymentSecretStore's CheckKeyRingCandidate needs no dialect loop of its own; the dialect coverage is in SecretStore's), so under multi-db/mysql it skips under its own BARE name with no /postgres suffix, which matches neither broad suffix line. Its own line here removes it from the unattributed pool instead.
same test as the multi-db/mysql lines above; multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so here it is the postgres arm that skips.
same test, same reason, the mysql arm.
same bare-named test as the multi-db/mysql line above; multi-db/mssql has no Postgres DSN either, so it skips here too.

the cluster job's CLEAT_TEST_DB gives it Postgres only (confirmed live: TestDeploymentSecretCheckKeyRingCandidateChecksTheCandidate, which needs only Postgres, runs rather than skipping there), so of this test's three forEachDialect arms only mysql and mssql skip.
same test, same reason, the mssql arm.

cleat#2158's required pairing for the two cluster lines above: engine-race.yml's CLEAT_TEST_DB is also Postgres-only (same shape as the cluster job), so this test's mysql arm skips there too, byte-identical regex to the cluster line. Without this, a missing test-go/engine line would be invisible until engine-race.yml's next 4-hourly run (cleat#2155) rather than caught per-PR.
